repos.description_zh: 面向 Web 与移动端应用的新一代端到端（e2e）测试框架。

repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.description_zh: 面向实战工程师的技能合集，直接取自我的 .agents 目录。

repos.name: text-to-cad
repos.description_zh: 面向 CAD、CAE 与 CAM 的智能体技能库。

repos.name: AnyPS5
repos.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
repos.description_zh: 将 PS5 可执行程序自动移植到 Linux 与 Windows 的工具。

repos.name: impeccable
repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.description_zh: 让你的 AI 宿主（harness）更懂设计的设计语言。

repos.name: claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.description_zh: 为所有智能体提供跨会话的持久化上下文——记录智能体在会话中产生的全部操作，用 AI 压缩后，将相关上下文注入未来的会话。兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等。

repos.name: i-have-adhd
repos.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
repos.description_zh: 一项让编程智能体别把答案埋在长篇大论里的技能，输出对 ADHD 人群友好。

repos.name: rea
repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.description_zh: 用智能体对任意对象进行逆向工程，从应用行为一直深入到底层原生二进制代码。

repos.name: DeepGEMM
repos.description: DeepGEMM: clean and efficient BLAS kernel library on GPU
repos.description_zh: DeepGEMM：干净高效的 GPU 端 BLAS 通用矩阵乘法计算内核库。

repos.name: agency-agents
repos.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
repos.description_zh: 指尖上的完整 AI 代理公司——从前端巫师到 Reddit 社群高手，从灵感注入器到现实校验员。每个智能体都是带个性、有流程、交付可验证成果的专精专家。

repos.name: openGym
repos.description: Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.
repos.description_zh: 自托管的健身房与自重训练记录工具——规划训练计划、记录训练内容（超级组、热身、有氧），查看哪些肌肉已被训练、疲劳或停训，支持从 FitNotes / Strong / Hevy 导入数据，采用通行密钥登录。数据归你，服务器也归你。

repos.name: diagram-design
repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.description_zh: 为 Claude Code、Codex 与 Pi 准备的 38 种编辑型图表模板。自包含 HTML + SVG，无阴影、告别 Mermaid 套话。
